name: redpact
description: Develop in chat with TDD, worktrees and Redpact-managed verification.

interface.shortDescription: Develop in chat and review recorded evidence.
interface.longDescription: Use redpact-init for project setup. Redpact guides test-first work in isolated checkouts, requests Unit, Integration and Playwright execution through MCP, and returns recorded evidence and review links. Ask policy leaves execution approval to the human through App controls. The host agent owns files and Git; Redpact owns execution and evidence. Local commands support iteration but do not replace connected acceptance evidence or human review.
defaultPrompt: Use $redpact to implement and test this feature.
Use $redpact current to develop this feature on the current checkout branch.
